profile.headline: Farmer and Passionate Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a passionate software engineer and farmer.  Equally at home on a tractor or in my home office writing and architecting code.  The two worlds help balance me out and allow me to be more creative and innovative in both.

MCP(Microsoft Certified Professional) in Visual Studio Team Foundation Server 2010

Specialties: SSRS(SQL Server Reporting Services), SSIS(SQL Server Integration Services), SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services), WSS (Windows SharePoint Services) 3.0, MOSS (Microsoft Office SharePoint Server) 2007, SharePoint 2010, C#, SQL, XML, XSLT, CSS, jQuery, JavaScript, HTML, WCF, TFS(Team Foundation Server), ASP.NET MVC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Architect
positions.description:
Senior Software Architect with UW Information Technology’s Data & Applications team, focused on enterprise systems, data platforms, business intelligence, and applied AI.
I also serve as the AI Champion for the Data & Applications organization, helping teams identify practical uses of AI, share lessons across UW-IT, and modernize how data and technology support the university.

positions.title: Farmer
positions.description: I run all aspects of our farm including crop planning, technology investment, resourcing, and operations.

company.name: Nelson Farms, Inc. & Silver Creek Farms, Inc.

positions.title: Chief Innovation Officer & Board Member
positions.description:
AgAnswers is building an AI operating system for agriculture, helping farmers make better decisions and reduce the administrative burden of running a farm.
I work with the team on product strategy, agricultural workflows, AI applications, and bringing a farmer’s perspective into how we design and build the platform. My focus is on practical tools that improve farmers’ lives and livelihoods, from operations and agronomy to finance and grain marketing.

positions.title: Owner, Software Engineer
positions.description: Independent Software Consultant.  Working on everything from technology strategy to full-stack development.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed new features on core MVC product.  Most features required front-end work in HTML and JavaScript, service layer work in C#, and back-end work in SQL.

volunteerExperiences.role: Board of Trustees of Washington Chapter

projects.title: Chicco USA e-Commerce Website
projects.description:
• e-commerce platform implementation (Demandware)
• integrations w/ SAP, Paymetric, Listrak
• UX/UI design to support the branded online experience
• fully responsive UI (desktop, tablet, mobile)
• ongoing site feature and content updates
